bio.fr: Duc d'York et amiral sous le règne de son frère Charles II, il donne son nom à New York, prise aux Hollandais en 1664. Roi catholique à partir de 1685, il est renversé en 1688 par la Glorieuse Révolution au profit de Guillaume d'Orange, et meurt en exil à Saint-Germain-en-Laye.
bio.en: As Duke of York and admiral under his brother Charles II, he lent his name to New York, taken from the Dutch in 1664. A Catholic king from 1685, he was ousted by the Glorious Revolution of 1688 in favour of William of Orange and died in exile at Saint-Germain-en-Laye.
